title: Next.js PostgreSQL Server Migration
description: Implement the full architecture migration from Go server + SQLite to Next.js + PostgreSQL + pg-boss. This includes: PostgreSQL schema, Next.js server with auth/API/dashboard, Go CLI refactoring to use server APIs, pg-boss background workers, Discord integration, Docker Compose deployment, migration tooling for existing history, and comprehensive testing.
summary: Fixed drag output so children move with parents. nativeDragPieces now takes kit + rawDesign + flatDesign, applies the drag diff to the raw design, then re-flattens so child positions are recomputed from the connection tree. Previously the diff was applied to the already-flattened design, leaving children at stale absolute positions.
